formal_statement: ∀ (x1 : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit), x1.size ≤ (14 : ℕ) → PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.FanInTwo x1 → x1.output ≤ (24 : ℕ) → x1.output ≠ (9 : ℕ) → (∀ x6 ∈ x1.gates, ∀ x8 ∈ x6.inputs, x8 ≤ (24 : ℕ) ∧ x8 ≠ (9 : ℕ)) → ∃ (x7 : Fin (9 : ℕ) → Bool), x1.eval (List.ofFn x7 ++ [x7 (4 : Fin (9 : ℕ)) && x7 (6 : Fin (9 : ℕ))]) ≠ (x7 (0 : Fin (9 : ℕ)) && x7 (1 : Fin (9 : ℕ)) || x7 (1 : Fin (9 : ℕ)) && x7 (2 : Fin (9 : ℕ)) || x7 (2 : Fin (9 : ℕ)) && x7 (3 : Fin (9 : ℕ)) || x7 (3 : Fin (9 : ℕ)) && x7 (4 : Fin (9 : ℕ)) || x7 (4 : Fin (9 : ℕ)) && x7 (0 : Fin (9 : ℕ)) || x7 (0 : Fin (9 : ℕ)) && x7 (5 : Fin (9 : ℕ)) || x7 (1 : Fin (9 : ℕ)) && x7 (6 : Fin (9 : ℕ)) || x7 (2 : Fin (9 : ℕ)) && x7 (7 : Fin (9 : ℕ)) || x7 (3 : Fin (9 : ℕ)) && x7 (8 : Fin (9 : ℕ)) || x7 (5 : Fin (9 : ℕ)) && x7 (7 : Fin (9 : ℕ)) || x7 (6 : Fin (9 : ℕ)) && x7 (8 : Fin (9 : ℕ)) || x7 (8 : Fin (9 : ℕ)) && x7 (5 : Fin (9 : ℕ)))
plain_statement: The edge function F of the Petersen graph minus a vertex (9 inputs, 12 edges, written as a list of two-digit codes ab for the edge a b). Give a circuit of AND, OR (two-input) and NOT gates the nine inputs and the wire AND(x_4, x_6). If it has at most 14 gates, none of them reads that wire and the output is not that wire, it does not compute F.
title: A step toward: Petersen graph minus a vertex: no AND, OR (fan-in two), NOT circuit with at most 15 gates and first gate AND(x_4, x_6) computes its edge function
